sentences.text: Anoche fuimos a un concierto.
sentences.translation: We went to a concert last night.

sentences.text: El concierto empieza a las nueve.
sentences.translation: The concert starts at nine.

sentences.text: Van a dar tres conciertos en Madrid.
sentences.translation: They are going to give three concerts in Madrid.

notes: por casualidad = by chance.

sentences.text: ¡Qué casualidad!
sentences.translation: What a coincidence!

sentences.text: Nos conocimos por casualidad.
sentences.translation: We met by chance.

sentences.text: La vida está llena de casualidades.
sentences.translation: Life is full of coincidences.

sentences.text: ¿Y qué excusa tienes esta vez?
sentences.translation: And what's your excuse this time?

sentences.text: Eso no es excusa para gritar.
sentences.translation: That's no excuse for shouting.

sentences.text: Estoy cansado de tus excusas.
sentences.translation: I'm tired of your excuses.

notes: de rodillas = on your knees.

sentences.text: Me caí y me hice daño en la rodilla.
sentences.translation: I fell and hurt my knee.

sentences.text: Se puso de rodillas.
sentences.translation: He got down on his knees.

sentences.text: El agua me llega a las rodillas.
sentences.translation: The water comes up to my knees.

notes: The plural is cruces.

sentences.text: En lo alto del monte hay una cruz.
sentences.translation: There's a cross at the top of the hill.

sentences.text: Marca la respuesta correcta con una cruz.
sentences.translation: Mark the right answer with a cross.

sentences.text: En el cementerio hay muchas cruces.
sentences.translation: There are many crosses in the cemetery.

sentences.text: Ponte cómodo.
sentences.translation: Make yourself comfortable.

sentences.text: ¿Estás cómoda en esa silla?
sentences.translation: Are you comfortable in that chair?

sentences.text: Para caminar, llevo zapatos cómodos.
sentences.translation: For walking, I wear comfortable shoes.

sentences.text: La vida a veces es cruel.
sentences.translation: Life is cruel sometimes.

sentences.text: Fue una broma muy cruel.
sentences.translation: It was a very cruel joke.

sentences.text: Los niños pueden ser muy crueles.
sentences.translation: Children can be very cruel.

sentences.text: Esta noche duermo en el sofá.
sentences.translation: Tonight I'm sleeping on the sofa.

sentences.text: El gato no puede subir al sofá.
sentences.translation: The cat isn't allowed on the sofa.

sentences.text: En el salón hay dos sofás.
sentences.translation: There are two sofas in the living room.

sentences.text: Una sombra pasó por delante de la puerta.
sentences.translation: A shadow passed in front of the door.

sentences.text: Por la tarde, las sombras son más largas.
sentences.translation: In the afternoon, shadows are longer.

sentences.text: Deja el coche a la sombra.
sentences.translation: Leave the car in the shade.

sentences.text: Ese árbol da mucha sombra.
sentences.translation: That tree gives a lot of shade.

notes: The noun is la firma (signature).

sentences.text: Firmo con la mano izquierda.
sentences.translation: I sign with my left hand.

sentences.text: ¿Dónde tengo que firmar?
sentences.translation: Where do I have to sign?

sentences.text: Firmamos el acuerdo ayer.
sentences.translation: We signed the agreement yesterday.

sentences.text: El jefe todavía no ha firmado.
sentences.translation: The boss hasn't signed yet.

sentences.text: Trabajo en el escritorio de mi habitación.
sentences.translation: I work at the desk in my room.

sentences.text: Deja las cartas encima del escritorio.
sentences.translation: Leave the letters on the desk.

sentences.text: En la oficina no quedan escritorios libres.
sentences.translation: There are no free desks left in the office.

sentences.text: Mi hija duerme con su muñeca.
sentences.translation: My daughter sleeps with her doll.

sentences.text: De pequeña tenía muchas muñecas.
sentences.translation: When I was little I had lots of dolls.

sentences.text: Se rompió la muñeca jugando al tenis.
sentences.translation: She broke her wrist playing tennis.

sentences.text: Lleva un reloj en cada muñeca.
sentences.translation: He wears a watch on each wrist.

notes: In Madrid, el Rastro is a famous street market.

sentences.text: La policía no encontró ningún rastro.
sentences.translation: The police didn't find any trace.

sentences.text: Se fue sin dejar rastro.
sentences.translation: He left without a trace.

sentences.text: El perro sigue el rastro del conejo.
sentences.translation: The dog is following the rabbit's trail.

sentences.text: Había rastros de sangre en el suelo.
sentences.translation: There were traces of blood on the floor.

notes: It is also an adjective: una pizza gigante = a huge pizza.

sentences.text: Al lado de su hermano parece un gigante.
sentences.translation: Next to his brother he looks like a giant.

sentences.text: En el cuento, los gigantes viven en las nubes.
sentences.translation: In the story, the giants live in the clouds.

sentences.text: De repente, el gigante abrió los ojos.
sentences.translation: Suddenly, the giant opened his eyes.

notes: ducharse = to have a shower.

sentences.text: Me voy a dar una ducha.
sentences.translation: I'm going to take a shower.

sentences.text: Después de correr, necesito una ducha.
sentences.translation: After running, I need a shower.

sentences.text: Las duchas del gimnasio siempre están sucias.
sentences.translation: The gym showers are always dirty.

sentences.text: Ofrecen una recompensa por el gato perdido.
sentences.translation: They're offering a reward for the lost cat.

sentences.text: Todo ese esfuerzo tuvo su recompensa.
sentences.translation: All that effort was rewarded.

sentences.text: El juego da recompensas cada día.
sentences.translation: The game gives rewards every day.

sentences.text: Un año tiene doce meses.
sentences.translation: A year has twelve months.

sentences.text: Mi sobrino cumple doce años en mayo.
sentences.translation: My nephew turns twelve in May.

sentences.text: Somos doce para cenar.
sentences.translation: There are twelve of us for dinner.

notes: A woman is una actriz; the plural is actrices.

sentences.text: Mi hermano quiere ser actor.
sentences.translation: My brother wants to be an actor.

sentences.text: Conocí a una actriz en el tren.
sentences.translation: I met an actress on the train.

sentences.text: Mis padres eran actores de teatro.
sentences.translation: My parents were stage actors.

sentences.text: Hay actitudes que no soporto.
sentences.translation: There are attitudes I can't stand.

sentences.text: Me encanta su actitud positiva.
sentences.translation: I love her positive attitude.

sentences.text: Con esa actitud no vas a llegar lejos.
sentences.translation: With that attitude you won't get far.

sentences.text: Esta salsa pica mucho.
sentences.translation: This sauce is very spicy.

sentences.text: Mi madre hace una salsa de tomate muy rica.
sentences.translation: My mother makes a really tasty tomato sauce.

sentences.text: Las patatas vienen con dos salsas.
sentences.translation: The potatoes come with two sauces.

sentences.text: El personaje principal es una niña de diez años.
sentences.translation: The main character is a ten-year-old girl.

sentences.text: La novela tiene demasiados personajes.
sentences.translation: The novel has too many characters.

sentences.text: Tu abuelo es todo un personaje.
sentences.translation: Your grandfather is quite a character.

notes: The verb is votar (to vote).

sentences.text: Cada voto cuenta.
sentences.translation: Every vote counts.

sentences.text: Ganó por solo diez votos.
sentences.translation: She won by just ten votes.

sentences.text: Le di mi voto a ella.
sentences.translation: I gave her my vote.

sentences.text: La entrega tarda tres días.
sentences.translation: Delivery takes three days.

sentences.text: Hacemos entregas a domicilio.
sentences.translation: We do home deliveries.

sentences.text: La fecha de entrega del trabajo es el viernes.
sentences.translation: The due date for the assignment is Friday.

notes: centro comercial = shopping centre.

sentences.text: Es una zona muy comercial.
sentences.translation: It's a very commercial area.

sentences.text: Tenemos una relación comercial con esa empresa.
sentences.translation: We have a business relationship with that company.

sentences.text: En las afueras hay dos centros comerciales.
sentences.translation: There are two shopping centres on the outskirts.

sentences.text: La tribu vive cerca del río.
sentences.translation: The tribe lives near the river.

sentences.text: En la selva viven muchas tribus.
sentences.translation: Many tribes live in the jungle.

sentences.text: Con cinco hijos, somos toda una tribu.
sentences.translation: With five kids, we're a whole tribe.

notes: un puro is also a cigar.

sentences.text: Fue pura suerte.
sentences.translation: It was pure luck.

sentences.text: Este anillo es de oro puro.
sentences.translation: This ring is pure gold.

sentences.text: Lo dijo por pura envidia.
sentences.translation: He said it out of pure envy.

sentences.text: Es la familia más poderosa del pueblo.
sentences.translation: It's the most powerful family in the town.

sentences.text: Tiene amigos muy poderosos.
sentences.translation: He has very powerful friends.

sentences.text: La música tiene un efecto poderoso.
sentences.translation: Music has a powerful effect.

notes: hace fresco = it's a bit cold.

sentences.text: Este pan no es fresco, es de ayer.
sentences.translation: This bread isn't fresh, it's from yesterday.

sentences.text: Prefiero comprar huevos frescos.
sentences.translation: I prefer to buy fresh eggs.

sentences.text: Por la noche la casa está más fresca.
sentences.translation: At night the house is cooler.

sentences.text: Abre la ventana, que entre aire fresco.
sentences.translation: Open the window to let some fresh air in.

gloss: to keep; to put away; to save

sentences.text: ¿Dónde guardas los platos?
sentences.translation: Where do you keep the plates?

sentences.text: Guarda los juguetes, por favor.
sentences.translation: Put the toys away, please.

sentences.text: ¿Has guardado el archivo?
sentences.translation: Have you saved the file?

notes: A woman is una senadora.

sentences.text: El senador habló ayer en la radio.
sentences.translation: The senator spoke on the radio yesterday.

sentences.text: Es senadora desde hace diez años.
sentences.translation: She has been a senator for ten years.

sentences.text: Hay senadores de todos los partidos.
sentences.translation: There are senators from every party.

notes: A woman is una campeona; the plural campeones has no accent.

sentences.text: ¡Somos los campeones!
sentences.translation: We are the champions!

sentences.text: Mi hija es campeona de España.
sentences.translation: My daughter is the Spanish champion.

sentences.text: ¡Vamos, campeón, tú puedes!
sentences.translation: Come on, champ, you can do it!

sentences.text: ¡Qué bebé tan adorable!
sentences.translation: What an adorable baby!

sentences.text: Tus hijos son adorables.
sentences.translation: Your kids are adorable.

sentences.text: Su abuela es una mujer adorable.
sentences.translation: His grandmother is a lovely woman.

notes: It is also a noun: un ciego = a blind man.

sentences.text: Mi abuelo está casi ciego.
sentences.translation: My grandfather is almost blind.

sentences.text: Se quedó ciega a los cuarenta años.
sentences.translation: She went blind at forty.

sentences.text: Hay perros que ayudan a las personas ciegas.
sentences.translation: There are dogs that help blind people.

sentences.text: Ese perro es una bestia.
sentences.translation: That dog is a beast.

sentences.text: La bestia tenía los ojos rojos.
sentences.translation: The beast had red eyes.

sentences.text: Esos hombres son unas bestias.
sentences.translation: Those men are brutes.

sentences.text: ¿Has visto el último episodio?
sentences.translation: Have you seen the latest episode?

sentences.text: La serie tiene diez episodios.
sentences.translation: The series has ten episodes.

sentences.text: Ese episodio de mi vida ya pasó.
sentences.translation: That episode of my life is behind me.

sentences.text: Lo llevaron a una celda.
sentences.translation: They took him to a cell.

sentences.text: La celda solo tiene una cama.
sentences.translation: The cell only has a bed.

sentences.text: Hay veinte celdas en esta cárcel.
sentences.translation: There are twenty cells in this prison.

gloss: to stand, to put up with; to hold on

sentences.text: Ya no aguanto más.
sentences.translation: I can't take it anymore.

sentences.text: ¡Aguanta, que ya viene la ayuda!
sentences.translation: Hold on, help is coming!

sentences.text: Aguantamos dos horas bajo la lluvia.
sentences.translation: We held out for two hours in the rain.

notes: The plural is also jueves.

sentences.text: El jueves tengo médico.
sentences.translation: On Thursday I have a doctor's appointment.

sentences.text: Los jueves voy a clase de inglés.
sentences.translation: On Thursdays I go to English class.

sentences.text: El jueves que viene es fiesta.
sentences.translation: Next Thursday is a holiday.

sentences.text: ¿Me has leído el pensamiento?
sentences.translation: Did you read my mind?

sentences.text: Ese pensamiento no me deja dormir.
sentences.translation: That thought keeps me awake.

sentences.text: Estaba perdida en sus pensamientos.
sentences.translation: She was lost in thought.

sentences.text: Volvimos a casa a medianoche.
sentences.translation: We got home at midnight.

sentences.text: Ya es medianoche, vámonos a dormir.
sentences.translation: It's already midnight, let's go to bed.

sentences.text: Después de la medianoche no hay autobuses.
sentences.translation: After midnight there are no buses.

sentences.text: Se me ha quedado algo en la garganta.
sentences.translation: Something's stuck in my throat.

sentences.text: Tengo la garganta fatal de tanto gritar.
sentences.translation: My throat is killing me from all the shouting.

sentences.text: El médico me miró la garganta.
sentences.translation: The doctor looked at my throat.

sentences.text: Mañana tenemos una sesión de fotos.
sentences.translation: Tomorrow we have a photo shoot.

sentences.text: El curso tiene ocho sesiones.
sentences.translation: The course has eight sessions.

sentences.text: La última sesión del cine es a las diez.
sentences.translation: The last showing at the cinema is at ten.

notes: In Spain, people often say el DNI for their ID card.

sentences.text: ¿Lleva usted alguna identificación?
sentences.translation: Are you carrying any ID?

sentences.text: Sin identificación no puedes votar.
sentences.translation: Without ID you can't vote.

sentences.text: Necesito ver su identificación.
sentences.translation: I need to see your ID.

sentences.text: Depende de las circunstancias.
sentences.translation: It depends on the circumstances.

sentences.text: En estas circunstancias, es mejor esperar.
sentences.translation: In these circumstances, it's better to wait.

sentences.text: Bajo ninguna circunstancia abras la puerta.
sentences.translation: Under no circumstances open the door.

sentences.text: Esa planta es veneno para los gatos.
sentences.translation: That plant is poison for cats.

sentences.text: Alguien puso veneno en su copa.
sentences.translation: Someone put poison in his glass.

sentences.text: El veneno tarda horas en hacer efecto.
sentences.translation: The poison takes hours to work.

sentences.text: La primavera llega en marzo.
sentences.translation: Spring arrives in March.

sentences.text: En primavera el campo está precioso.
sentences.translation: In spring the countryside is beautiful.

sentences.text: Nos casamos la primavera pasada.
sentences.translation: We got married last spring.

notes: Use aquello for a thing far away or long ago, not for a person.

sentences.text: ¿Ves aquello de allí, junto al río?
sentences.translation: Do you see that thing over there, by the river?

sentences.text: Aquello pasó hace muchos años.
sentences.translation: That happened many years ago.

sentences.text: ¿Te acuerdas de aquello que te conté?
sentences.translation: Do you remember that thing I told you?

notes: The plural is also martes.

sentences.text: Te llamo el martes por la mañana.
sentences.translation: I'll call you on Tuesday morning.

sentences.text: El martes es mi día libre.
sentences.translation: Tuesday is my day off.

sentences.text: Cada martes como con mi madre.
sentences.translation: Every Tuesday I have lunch with my mother.

sentences.text: Mi perro es feo, pero lo quiero mucho.
sentences.translation: My dog is ugly, but I love him a lot.

sentences.text: Me veo fea con esta falda.
sentences.translation: I look ugly in this skirt.

sentences.text: Hay edificios muy feos en el centro.
sentences.translation: There are some very ugly buildings in the centre.

sentences.text: Se ha quedado un día feo.
sentences.translation: The weather has turned nasty.

sentences.text: Mi oficina está en otro distrito.
sentences.translation: My office is in another district.

sentences.text: La ciudad tiene veinte distritos.
sentences.translation: The city has twenty districts.

sentences.text: En este distrito hay muchas tiendas.
sentences.translation: There are a lot of shops in this district.

sentences.text: Este restaurante tiene buena reputación.
sentences.translation: This restaurant has a good reputation.

sentences.text: No quiero perder mi reputación.
sentences.translation: I don't want to lose my reputation.

sentences.text: Con esa reputación, nadie le da trabajo.
sentences.translation: With that reputation, nobody gives him work.

notes: People shout it when they are in danger.

sentences.text: ¡Socorro, un ladrón!
sentences.translation: Help, a thief!

sentences.text: ¡Socorro! ¡Que alguien llame a un médico!
sentences.translation: Help! Somebody call a doctor!

sentences.text: Oí a una mujer gritar: «¡Socorro!».
sentences.translation: I heard a woman shout, "Help!"

sentences.text: Como castigo, no hay tele esta semana.
sentences.translation: As a punishment, no TV this week.

sentences.text: Me parece un castigo justo.
sentences.translation: I think it's a fair punishment.

sentences.text: Con castigos no se aprende nada.
sentences.translation: You don't learn anything from punishments.

sentences.text: Hay un límite de mil euros al día.
sentences.translation: There's a limit of a thousand euros a day.

sentences.text: Mi paciencia tiene límites.
sentences.translation: My patience has limits.

sentences.text: ¿Hay algún límite de edad?
sentences.translation: Is there an age limit?

notes: In a theatre, people say el público.

sentences.text: El programa tiene mucha audiencia.
sentences.translation: The show has a big audience.

sentences.text: La radio ha perdido audiencia.
sentences.translation: Radio has lost listeners.

sentences.text: Es el partido con más audiencia del año.
sentences.translation: It's the most-watched match of the year.

notes: nací = I was born; nació = he or she was born.

sentences.text: Cada año nacen menos niños.
sentences.translation: Fewer children are born every year.

sentences.text: ¿Dónde naciste?
sentences.translation: Where were you born?

sentences.text: Mi hijo nació en invierno.
sentences.translation: My son was born in winter.

sentences.text: Acaba de nacer el bebé de mi hermana.
sentences.translation: My sister's baby has just been born.

notes: A woman is una jugadora.

sentences.text: Es el mejor jugador del equipo.
sentences.translation: He's the best player on the team.

sentences.text: Mi hermana es jugadora de baloncesto.
sentences.translation: My sister is a basketball player.

sentences.text: Nos faltan dos jugadores.
sentences.translation: We're two players short.

sentences.text: La escalera está llena de humo.
sentences.translation: The stairwell is full of smoke.

sentences.text: Me molesta el humo del tabaco.
sentences.translation: Tobacco smoke bothers me.

sentences.text: Sale humo del coche.
sentences.translation: Smoke is coming out of the car.

sentences.text: Este juego es muy popular entre los niños.
sentences.translation: This game is very popular with children.

sentences.text: Esa canción se ha hecho muy popular.
sentences.translation: That song has become very popular.

sentences.text: Los bares más populares están en el centro.
sentences.translation: The most popular bars are in the centre.

sentences.text: El rey habló a toda la nación.
sentences.translation: The king spoke to the whole nation.

sentences.text: Todas las naciones tienen su bandera.
sentences.translation: All nations have their own flag.

sentences.text: España es una nación muy antigua.
sentences.translation: Spain is a very old nation.

notes: Soldiers are usually las tropas, in the plural.

sentences.text: Las tropas llegaron al pueblo de noche.
sentences.translation: The troops reached the town at night.

sentences.text: El general habló a sus tropas.
sentences.translation: The general spoke to his troops.

sentences.text: Mira, ahí viene toda la tropa.
sentences.translation: Look, here comes the whole gang.

sentences.text: Todo tiene una explicación.
sentences.translation: There's an explanation for everything.

sentences.text: No me debes ninguna explicación.
sentences.translation: You don't owe me any explanation.

sentences.text: Sus explicaciones eran muy claras.
sentences.translation: Her explanations were very clear.

sentences.text: ¿Cómo celebras la Navidad?
sentences.translation: How do you celebrate Christmas?

sentences.text: ¡Has aprobado! Hay que celebrarlo.
sentences.translation: You passed! We have to celebrate.

sentences.text: Celebraron la boda en su pueblo.
sentences.translation: They held the wedding in their home town.

notes: A sports competition is una competición in Spain.

sentences.text: En este sector la competencia es muy fuerte.
sentences.translation: In this sector the competition is very tough.

sentences.text: Esa tienda es de la competencia.
sentences.translation: That shop belongs to the competition.

sentences.text: Los precios de la competencia son más bajos.
sentences.translation: The competition's prices are lower.

notes: False friend: a bookshop is una librería.

sentences.text: Estudio en la biblioteca por las tardes.
sentences.translation: I study at the library in the afternoons.

sentences.text: ¿A qué hora cierra la biblioteca?
sentences.translation: What time does the library close?

sentences.text: En la ciudad hay cinco bibliotecas.
sentences.translation: There are five libraries in the city.

notes: A queue to wait in is usually una cola in Spain.

sentences.text: Nos sentamos en la primera fila.
sentences.translation: We sat in the front row.

sentences.text: Niños, en fila, por favor.
sentences.translation: Kids, line up, please.

sentences.text: Al fondo quedan dos filas libres.
sentences.translation: There are two free rows at the back.

sentences.text: Su muerte sigue siendo un misterio.
sentences.translation: His death is still a mystery.

sentences.text: No tiene ningún misterio: es muy fácil.
sentences.translation: There's no mystery to it: it's very easy.

sentences.text: El mar todavía guarda muchos misterios.
sentences.translation: The sea still holds many mysteries.

notes: A woman is una ganadora.

sentences.text: Al final, el ganador fue mi hermano.
sentences.translation: In the end, the winner was my brother.

sentences.text: La ganadora se lleva mil euros.
sentences.translation: The winner takes home a thousand euros.

sentences.text: Los ganadores salen mañana en el periódico.
sentences.translation: The winners will be in the newspaper tomorrow.

sentences.text: Vivo cerca del puerto.
sentences.translation: I live near the port.

sentences.text: Desde el puerto salen barcos a las islas.
sentences.translation: Boats leave from the port for the islands.

sentences.text: Es uno de los puertos más grandes de Europa.
sentences.translation: It's one of the biggest ports in Europe.

sentences.text: Bajen del vehículo, por favor.
sentences.translation: Please get out of the vehicle.

sentences.text: El vehículo iba demasiado rápido.
sentences.translation: The vehicle was going too fast.

sentences.text: No se permiten vehículos en el centro.
sentences.translation: Vehicles aren't allowed in the centre.

notes: Months are written in lowercase.

sentences.text: En julio y agosto hay muchos turistas.
sentences.translation: In July and August there are lots of tourists.

sentences.text: Me voy de vacaciones en julio.
sentences.translation: I'm going on holiday in July.

sentences.text: Mi cumpleaños es el diez de julio.
sentences.translation: My birthday is on the tenth of July.

sentences.text: No logro dormir con este ruido.
sentences.translation: I can't get to sleep with this noise.

sentences.text: ¡Lo hemos logrado!
sentences.translation: We did it!

sentences.text: Logró terminar la carrera a los cuarenta.
sentences.translation: She managed to finish her degree at forty.

gloss: to take away; to take off
notes: quitarse = to take off (clothes): quítate el abrigo.

sentences.text: Me quito las gafas para leer.
sentences.translation: I take my glasses off to read.

sentences.text: Quita los pies de la mesa.
sentences.translation: Take your feet off the table.

sentences.text: ¿Quién ha quitado mis cosas de aquí?
sentences.translation: Who has taken my things from here?

sentences.text: Mi ventana da al patio.
sentences.translation: My window looks onto the courtyard.

sentences.text: El patio del colegio es muy pequeño.
sentences.translation: The school playground is very small.

sentences.text: Las casas del sur tienen patios con flores.
sentences.translation: Houses in the south have courtyards with flowers.

notes: The noun is el golpe (a blow).

sentences.text: El viento golpea las ventanas.
sentences.translation: The wind is beating against the windows.

sentences.text: Alguien lo golpeó por la espalda.
sentences.translation: Someone hit him from behind.

sentences.text: No golpees la mesa, por favor.
sentences.translation: Don't bang on the table, please.

sentences.text: Tirar la comida es un pecado.
sentences.translation: Throwing food away is a sin.

sentences.text: El chocolate es mi pecado favorito.
sentences.translation: Chocolate is my favourite sin.

sentences.text: Dios perdona los pecados.
sentences.translation: God forgives sins.

sentences.text: Ella forma parte del comité.
sentences.translation: She's on the committee.

sentences.text: El comité decidió cancelar la fiesta.
sentences.translation: The committee decided to cancel the party.

sentences.text: Hay demasiados comités en esta empresa.
sentences.translation: There are too many committees in this company.

sentences.text: ¡Qué emocionante!
sentences.translation: How exciting!

sentences.text: El final del partido fue emocionante.
sentences.translation: The end of the match was exciting.

sentences.text: Fueron unos días muy emocionantes.
sentences.translation: Those were some very exciting days.

sentences.text: El rescate duró toda la noche.
sentences.translation: The rescue lasted all night.

sentences.text: Los perros de rescate encontraron al niño.
sentences.translation: The rescue dogs found the boy.

sentences.text: Pidieron un rescate de un millón de euros.
sentences.translation: They asked for a ransom of a million euros.

sentences.text: No recuerdo el título de la canción.
sentences.translation: I can't remember the title of the song.

sentences.text: Por fin tengo mi título de enfermera.
sentences.translation: I finally have my nursing degree.

sentences.text: El club ha ganado tres títulos este año.
sentences.translation: The club has won three titles this year.

sentences.text: ¿A que no adivinas a quién he visto?
sentences.translation: You'll never guess who I saw.

sentences.text: Adivina cuántos años tengo.
sentences.translation: Guess how old I am.

sentences.text: Lo adivinó a la primera.
sentences.translation: She guessed it on the first try.

sentences.text: Hubo pánico en el metro.
sentences.translation: There was panic in the metro.

sentences.text: Le tengo pánico al dentista.
sentences.translation: I'm terrified of the dentist.

sentences.text: Tuvo un ataque de pánico.
sentences.translation: She had a panic attack.

notes: It is also an adjective: la puerta exterior = the outer door.

sentences.text: Han pintado el exterior del edificio.
sentences.translation: They've painted the outside of the building.

sentences.text: Desde el exterior no se ve nada.
sentences.translation: You can't see anything from the outside.

sentences.text: El exterior del coche está muy sucio.
sentences.translation: The outside of the car is very dirty.

sentences.text: La música es su pasión.
sentences.translation: Music is her passion.

sentences.text: Habla de fútbol con pasión.
sentences.translation: He talks about football with passion.

sentences.text: Sus grandes pasiones son el cine y la cocina.
sentences.translation: Her great passions are film and cooking.

gloss: to prepare, to make; to get ready

sentences.text: Estoy preparando una sorpresa para mi madre.
sentences.translation: I'm preparing a surprise for my mother.

sentences.text: ¿Quién preparó esta sopa?
sentences.translation: Who made this soup?

sentences.text: Preparamos el examen juntos.
sentences.translation: We studied for the exam together.

sentences.text: Prepárate, que nos vamos.
sentences.translation: Get ready, we're leaving.

notes: Some forms change o to ue: demuestro, demuestra.

sentences.text: Esto demuestra que no estaba en casa.
sentences.translation: This proves he wasn't at home.

sentences.text: Demostró que tenía razón.
sentences.translation: She proved she was right.

sentences.text: Has demostrado mucho valor.
sentences.translation: You've shown a lot of courage.

sentences.text: ¿Puedes demostrarlo?
sentences.translation: Can you prove it?

sentences.text: Hoy vas muy elegante.
sentences.translation: You look very smart today.

sentences.text: Mi abuela siempre fue muy elegante.
sentences.translation: My grandmother was always very elegant.

sentences.text: Llevaban unos trajes muy elegantes.
sentences.translation: They were wearing very elegant suits.

notes: The noun is la visita (a visit).

sentences.text: Visito a mi abuela cada semana.
sentences.translation: I visit my grandmother every week.

sentences.text: ¿Has visitado el museo nuevo?
sentences.translation: Have you visited the new museum?

sentences.text: Vinieron a visitarnos en verano.
sentences.translation: They came to visit us in the summer.

notes: medio ambiente = the environment (nature).

sentences.text: Me gusta el ambiente de este bar.
sentences.translation: I like the atmosphere in this bar.

sentences.text: En la oficina hay muy buen ambiente.
sentences.translation: There's a really good atmosphere at the office.

sentences.text: Hay que cuidar el medio ambiente.
sentences.translation: We have to look after the environment.

notes: urgencias = the emergency department at a hospital.

sentences.text: Tranquilo, no es urgente.
sentences.translation: Relax, it's not urgent.

sentences.text: Tengo que hacer una llamada urgente.
sentences.translation: I need to make an urgent call.

sentences.text: Tengo varios asuntos urgentes.
sentences.translation: I have several urgent matters.

sentences.text: Pagamos demasiados impuestos.
sentences.translation: We pay too much tax.

sentences.text: El precio incluye los impuestos.
sentences.translation: The price includes tax.

sentences.text: Van a subir el impuesto de la gasolina.
sentences.translation: They're going to raise the tax on petrol.

sentences.text: Hoy te veo distinta.
sentences.translation: You look different today.

sentences.text: Cada niño es distinto.
sentences.translation: Every child is different.

sentences.text: Vivimos en ciudades distintas.
sentences.translation: We live in different cities.

sentences.text: No es el momento adecuado.
sentences.translation: It's not the right time.

sentences.text: Busco la palabra adecuada.
sentences.translation: I'm looking for the right word.

sentences.text: Esos zapatos no son adecuados para la nieve.
sentences.translation: Those shoes aren't suitable for the snow.

gloss: to abandon, to leave; to give up

sentences.text: Hay gente que abandona a sus perros en verano.
sentences.translation: Some people abandon their dogs in the summer.

sentences.text: Abandonó a su familia hace años.
sentences.translation: He left his family years ago.

sentences.text: Ha abandonado los estudios.
sentences.translation: She has given up her studies.

sentences.text: Tuvimos que abandonar el edificio.
sentences.translation: We had to leave the building.

notes: apestar a = to stink of.

sentences.text: Este queso apesta.
sentences.translation: This cheese stinks.

sentences.text: Tus pies apestan.
sentences.translation: Your feet stink.

sentences.text: El coche apestaba a perro.
sentences.translation: The car stank of dog.

sentences.text: Mi gato es muy curioso.
sentences.translation: My cat is very curious.

sentences.text: Es curioso que no haya llamado.
sentences.translation: It's strange that he hasn't called.

sentences.text: Me pasó una cosa muy curiosa.
sentences.translation: Something very strange happened to me.

notes: The feminine is cara, which is also the word for face.

sentences.text: El tren es más caro que el autobús.
sentences.translation: The train is more expensive than the bus.

sentences.text: Siempre pide los platos más caros.
sentences.translation: He always orders the most expensive dishes.

sentences.text: Ese error te va a salir caro.
sentences.translation: That mistake is going to cost you dearly.

sentences.text: ¡Qué asco!
sentences.translation: How disgusting!

sentences.text: Me da asco tocar eso.
sentences.translation: Touching that disgusts me.

sentences.text: Este baño está hecho un asco.
sentences.translation: This bathroom is filthy.

sentences.text: Mi madre enseña inglés en un instituto.
sentences.translation: My mother teaches English at a secondary school.

sentences.text: Mi abuelo me enseñó a pescar.
sentences.translation: My grandfather taught me to fish.

sentences.text: Ven, que te enseño la casa.
sentences.translation: Come on, I'll show you the house.

sentences.text: Enséñame las fotos del viaje.
sentences.translation: Show me the photos from the trip.

sentences.text: El barco se perdió en medio del océano.
sentences.translation: The boat got lost in the middle of the ocean.

sentences.text: Cruzar el océano en barco lleva semanas.
sentences.translation: Crossing the ocean by boat takes weeks.

sentences.text: Hay mucho plástico en los océanos.
sentences.translation: There's a lot of plastic in the oceans.
